title: A race condition in the handling of the forward notification requests queue can lead to a crash if too many UDP notify…
description: CVE-2026-123758 describes a race condition vulnerability in the handling of the forward notification requests queue. This flaw can cause a crash when a large number of UDP notify packets for a specific zone are received in a short period. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.4, indicating a moderate impact primarily on availability.
